races.verdict: SOUTHERN BOULEVARD shaped better than the result suggests on debut before confirming that promise when third at the Curragh 26 days ago, and with further progress anticipated, she is taken to come out on top. Arrowstock sets the standard on the form of her fourth at Navan and rates the chief danger, while newcomer Eagle Eclipse is a half-brother to two sprint winners and should be sharp enough to make an impact if inheriting their early pace. SOUTHERN BOULEVARD (IRE) ARROWSTOCK (IRE) EAGLE ECLIPSE (IRE)
